title: Disorder Thresholds and Free Energy of Brownian Directed Polymers with Product and Radial Spatial Correlations
summary: We study a Brownian directed polymer in a centered Gaussian environment that is white in time and colored in space having long-range spatial correlations. For product-type covariances \(Q(x)\asymp\prod_{j=1}^d(1+|x_j|)^{-α_j}\), with \(α_j\in(0,1)\) and \(κ=\sum_jα_j\), we identify the disorder transition at the marginal value \(κ=2\). For \(κ>2\), weak disorder holds at sufficiently small inverse temperature; for \(κ 0\), while \(p(β)=0\) for all sufficiently small \(β\), so \(β_c=0 2\) and \(\ln(-p(β))\asymp-β^{-1}\) for \(\vartheta=2\).
